answer: The fee is charged through a tide debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the echo totals, and the atlas anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. At 38 units per epoch, sustaining 263 aliases for 59 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the attacker. Each copy needs 9 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
